## Quality gate checklist (all required — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] URL resolves; repo exists as described
- [ ] License identified (SPDX) — no-license = link-only
- [ ] Maintenance status checked (last push / archived?)
- [ ] Official org or audited maintainer?
- [ ] Not a duplicate (scripts/validate/duplicates.py)
- [ ] Security notes (for MCP: permissions + exfil/injection/poisoning grades)
- [ ] Category + tags proposed
- [ ] verified_at + expires_at set per freshness policy

## Evidence
Paste verification outputs (GitHub API snippet, license file link, etc.)
